# Admin MCP server

<!-- Generated by `go run docs/roadmap/gen.go docs` from tickets.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Phase:** [P4 · Agents everywhere](../README.md#phase-4--agents-everywhere) · **Lane:** Control plane · **Label:** `feature:admin-mcp` · **Epic:** [#200](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/200) · **Tickets:** 6 (2S 4M)

`warden admin-mcp` is an MCP server for operators' own AI assistants, with tools to explain a decision, query traffic, suggest and replay policy, and list agents. It authenticates to the CP with a scoped API key, is read-only by default, and never returns bodies or secrets.

## How we build it

- The command is a thin MCP server that calls CP REST APIs; it has no direct DB access. Flags: `--transport stdio|http`, `--listen :7071`, `--cp-url`, `--api-key-env WARDEN_API_KEY` (default), `--allow-writes`.
- Tools map to API key scopes: explain_decision -> `audit:read`; query_traffic -> `traffic:read`; list_agents -> `agents:read`; suggest_policy, replay_policy -> `policy:read`. The server lists only tools the key's scopes allow (checked via `GET /api/keys/self`).
- explain_decision(event_uid | agent+domain+time) calls new CP `GET /api/explain` which loads the policy version active at the event time, re-runs `policy.NewEvaluator` and returns matched rule, identity, grant, hook and MCP findings.
- query_traffic uses `EventFilter`/`AggregatedFilter` with typed filters (agent, sub, domain, decision, tool, since, limit<=500); no free-form SQL.
- suggest_policy wraps `policybuilder.Build` + `FormatYAML`; replay_policy wraps `policyeval.Evaluate` on fleet events. The only write tool, create_policy_draft, needs `--allow-writes` and `policy:draft`; nothing can approve or publish.
- HTTP mode serves Streamable HTTP at `/mcp` and requires the caller to present the same API key as Bearer; responses are size-capped (256 KB).

## Done when

Claude Code connected to `warden admin-mcp` with a read-only key can explain a specific deny, query recent traffic and replay a candidate policy, and cannot change anything.

### 1/6 · W-P4-AMCP-01

**Add CP explain and traffic query APIs**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#201](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/201)

In internal/controlplane add `GET /api/explain?event_uid=` (or agent, domain, ts) that loads the event from the fleet store, fetches the policy version active at ts from the policy history store and re-evaluates with `policy.NewEvaluator`, returning {decision, matchedRule, identity, grantId, reason, findings}. Add `GET /api/traffic` with typed filters over `GetEvents`/`GetAggregatedEvents`, limit capped at 500. Scope checks: `audit:read`, `traffic:read`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Explain returns the rule that matched under the historical policy version
- [ ] Traffic query rejects limit > 500 and unknown filters
- [ ] Responses contain no URL query strings or bodies

**Unblocks:** [`W-P4-AMCP-02`](admin-mcp.md#26--w-p4-amcp-02) Add admin-mcp command with stdio and HTTP transports

### 2/6 · W-P4-AMCP-02

**Add admin-mcp command with stdio and HTTP transports**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#202](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/202)

Add `newAdminMCPCmd()` in cmd/proxy registered in root.go, backed by new package internal/adminmcp with a tool registry and JSON-RPC handler for initialize, tools/list and tools/call. stdio reads newline-delimited JSON-RPC; HTTP serves Streamable HTTP at `/mcp` on `--listen` and requires Bearer API key. On start it calls `GET /api/keys/self` to read scopes and exposes only permitted tools.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Key with only policy:read lists only policy tools
- [ ] HTTP request without Bearer key gets 401
- [ ] Invalid API key fails startup with a clear error

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-AMCP-01`](admin-mcp.md#16--w-p4-amcp-01) Add CP explain and traffic query APIs

### 3/6 · W-P4-AMCP-03

**Implement explain_decision, query_traffic, list_agents**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#203](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/203)

Implement the three read tools in internal/adminmcp with JSON Schemas for inputs, calling the CP APIs. Output is a short text summary plus structured content; cap results at 256 KB and truncate with a marker. list_agents returns agent id, registry status, last seen worker and identity mode.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Each tool validates input against its schema
- [ ] Truncation marker is set when output exceeds the cap
- [ ] Tests use a fake CP from test/fakes

### 4/6 · W-P4-AMCP-04

**Implement suggest_policy and replay_policy tools**

Type **feature** · Size **M** · Issue [#204](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/204)

Add CP `POST /api/policy/suggest` wrapping `policybuilder.Build` and `FormatYAML`, and `POST /api/policy/replay` that parses candidate YAML (or a draft id) and runs `policyeval.Evaluate` against fleet events since a duration. Expose both as admin-mcp tools returning NewAllows/NewDenies grouped as in `EvalResult`.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Replay of current policy reports zero diffs
- [ ] Candidate that opens a denied domain shows it in NewAllows
- [ ] Invalid YAML returns a tool error, not a crash

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-AMCP-02`](admin-mcp.md#26--w-p4-amcp-02) Add admin-mcp command with stdio and HTTP transports

### 5/6 · W-P4-AMCP-05

**Add opt-in create_policy_draft write tool**

Type **feature** · Size **S** · Issue [#205](https://github.com/ethosagent/warden/issues/205)

Register `create_policy_draft` only when `--allow-writes` is set and the key has `policy:draft`; it creates a draft in the policy store with source=`admin-mcp` and the key id as author. It cannot approve, publish or roll back. Admin audit records the call.

**Acceptance criteria**

- [ ] Tool is absent without --allow-writes
- [ ] Draft is created pending approval, not published
- [ ] Audit record names the API key

**Depends on:** [`W-P4-AMCP-04`](admin-mcp.md#46--w-p4-amcp-04) Implement suggest_policy and replay_policy tools
